description:
Check whether a workspace already exists for a firm, slug, domain, owner email, or idempotency key.

This is read-only. Agents should call this before create_workspace so existing firm workspaces are reused instead of accidentally creating duplicates.

clientDomain.description: Firm/client domain used for idempotent matching

idempotencyKey.description: Stable idempotency key from a prior workspace request

workspaceName.description: Workspace display name to look up

name: resolve_workspace
